lines.text: Every day, buyers walk onto your floor.
They have seen the car. They have agreed the price.
Then comes the question: how will I pay?
For most buyers, the answer is finance. And when the finance is not there, the sale walks out of the door.
Showroom owners told us: for every ten cars they sell, about four more ready buyers leave without one.
AutoLink was built to close that gap.
With AutoLink, financing comes to your floor.
Your team submits the buyer's request through the AutoLink dealer portal, then follows it, step by step.
Your buyer does not have to leave to find a loan.
The portal works for your showroom, too. Your requests, your reports and your account, in one dashboard.
In Arabic, in English, or in Chinese.
And we do not just hand you a login. Our team sits down with your sales staff and trains them, on the portal, and on the conversation with the buyer.
Let them finish. Reflect before you respond. Ask one clarifying question. Then answer, briefly.
And this is only the beginning. Next on our roadmap: matching every buyer to the right lender, for faster approvals.
Then, your stock online, and new buyers sent straight to your door.
Twenty showrooms have already signed with AutoLink. Yours could be next.
AutoLink. Every buyer on your floor, a buyer you can finance.
Riyadh's independent car market trades billions of riyals a year.
Until now, no one had ever counted it.
So we walked it. A small field team, door to door, by day and after dark, across Al Qaadiseeya and Al Shiffa.
Every showroom, recorded on one uniform sheet: stock, prices, finance and contacts.
Five hundred and twenty showrooms. Five hundred and sixteen, pinned at their GPS coordinates.
Thirty one thousand, nine hundred and forty four cars, counted on the floor. Three point six billion riyals of stock on display.
Then we sat down with the owners. Twenty five of them opened their books.
From their numbers, Al Qaadiseeya alone sells an estimated fifteen point seven billion riyals of cars a year. And that is the conservative figure.
And we found where the money leaks. Eleven of thirteen floors have no bank on site.
In Al Shiffa, one hundred and ninety four of two hundred and eleven floors sell for cash only.
On just twenty four floors, ready buyers worth one point four billion riyals a year walk away, for want of a loan.
No one else holds this. It is the largest sub-dealer mapping of its kind, on one standard, ahead of every established player.
And it is already moving. We built a dealer portal for financing requests, trained the sales teams to use it, and earned the owners' trust, over coffee and dates.
In one month, twenty sub-dealers signed with AutoLink, and sixteen more have agreements in hand. Sixty four in the pipeline.
And we are already at the table with nine banks and finance companies.
Our founder put it simply.
We are not here to map a market. We are here to move it. For every dealer, every buyer, every lender.
AutoLink. From the showroom floor, to KAFD.
